paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Kindaichi quietly interrupted him. "Chief, the one who made the hand print that day was the real Kiyo. That's the big blind spot that was preventing me from seeing the truth. What better proof of identity than having identical fingerprints? It never occurred to me that the real Kiyo and his imposter had cleverly taken advantage of that mask and switched places."

paragraphs.source_en: Tamayo returned Kindaichi's gaze in silence, but soon, a faint color rising to her cheeks, she rose, bowed slightly, and quietly left the room.
